What you'll do


Scaled Adoption Managers are an integral part of the Customer Success Account Management team, responsible for overseeing a portfolio of accounts at scale and ensuring an exceptional customer experience. Their success is measured by metrics such as net revenue retention, decreased churn, and increased product usage.

In this role, Scaled Adoption Manager performs hands-on, tactical account management activities and works collaboratively with cross functional teams to orchestrate customer engagement, facilitate product enablement, reduce friction, increase product adoption, and demonstrate value throughout the customer lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is adept at managing customer relationships on a broad scale, delivering consistent experiences to ensure outstanding customer value realization and loyalty.

This position is an Individual Contributor role reporting to Manager, Scaled Adoption.


Responsibility

  • Drive customer adoption and value realization through short term adoption focused engagements
  • Drive value with key partners, as measured by renewal outcomes
  • Engage customers and internal partners proactively through telephony and digital campaigns
  • Escalate issues quickly when deep, specific skills or other capabilities are required
  • Leverage deep Docusign product knowledge to provide customer resolution and account recommendations
  • Provide critical feedback to influence product and tool improvements to enhance the customer experience
  • Promote Docusign products and services to customers via consultative discussion, product tutorials, and evaluation of their service and support needs
  • Conduct select business reviews with critical customers to ensure adoption, maximization of product value, and customer objective alignment
  • Evaluate portfolios and effectively analyze usage, health, data, and behavioral patterns to prioritize time to render the most favorable outcomes for the customer and Docusign
  • Collaborate with internal resources such as, but not limited to, Sales, Customer Success, Pricing, Legal, Revenue Operations, Billing and Sales Operations, to develop growth and risk mitigation strategies for key accounts
  • Follow and adhere to best practices for all internal processes including, opportunity management, data quality and accuracy, CRM hygiene, quotes and forecasting

Job Designation


Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring


Basic

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience in a customer facing role in a SaaS or related environment e.g., technical or customer support, enablement, account management, or customer success
  • Experience working with customer relationship management (CRM) software and other relevant tools
  • Multi-lingual in English and Portuguese

Preferred

  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills to manage multiple customer
    accounts simultaneously without compromise to quality or timeliness
  • Ability to communicate and influence, both written and over the phone, with audiences including customers, peers, management, and internal partners
  • Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and customer needs
  • Ability to view challenges and setbacks as opportunities to grow and learn
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically
  • High level of empathy and the ability to understand and anticipate customer needs
  • Positive demeanor and a proactive approach to addressing issues and finding solutions
  • Self-learning (active learning) and capable of applying what you learned
  • Multi-lingual in other Docusign supported languages (Spanish and/or French)
  • Professional experience within relevant industries for which Docusign provides solutions
  • Ability to analyze customer data and metrics to drive decisions and improvements
  • Ability to present complex topics in an understandable way to a group of customers
  • Salesforce and Gainsight experience
  • Self-motivated, highly collaborative, creative, team-centric, goal and growth-oriented

Life at Docusign


Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

  • Domínio avançado de Microsoft Excel e habilidade em leitura e interpretação de relatórios gerenciais e dashboards de BI.

Diferenciais

  • Capacidade de liderança, gestão de equipes e desenvolvimento de parceiros comerciais.

Benefícios

title: Diretor De Operações
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um Diretor de Operações (Perfuração) para integrar o time de um de seus maiores clientes no setor de Petróleo e Gás no Rio de Janeiro, RJ.

Como Diretor de Operações de Perfuração, você será responsável por supervisionar todo o planejamento e a execução de campanhas de perfuração, garantindo segurança, conformidade regulatória, eficiência operacional e alinhamento com as expectativas da empresa e clientes.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar todo o ciclo das operações de perfuração, desde o planejamento do poço e mobilização da sonda até a execução e análise pós-operação.
  • Gerenciar contratados de perfuração e prestadores de serviço, assegurando o cumprimento dos padrões técnicos e de segurança.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de controle de custos para otimizar os orçamentos de perfuração (CAPEX/OPEX).
  • Supervisionar a seleção de sondas e garantir conformidade com as regras de aceitação de sondas da Petrobras e os requisitos do RASMA.
  • Manter rigorosa conformidade com as normas da ANP e as NRs (Normas Regulamentadoras) brasileiras relacionadas à segurança, meio ambiente e saúde ocupacional.
  • Coordenar a preparação técnica e a documentação para auditorias e inspeções da Petrobras.
  • Identificar, documentar e liderar o encerramento de itens de não conformidade (Categorias A, B e C), conforme a classificação da Petrobras.
  • Atuar como elo principal entre as partes interessadas internas e órgãos reguladores (ANP, Petrobras, IBAMA, etc.).
  • Monitorar e reportar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs), incluindo ROP, NPT e prazos de entrega de poços.
  • Promover uma cultura orientada para a segurança por meio de programas proativos de SMS, investigações de incidentes e gestão de riscos.

Conformidade e Regulação

  • Familiaridade com as regras da Petrobras para aceitação de sondas de perfuração, incluindo especificações de equipamentos, protocolos de inspeção e requisitos de documentação.
  • Capacidade de comunicar e resolver não conformidades classificadas como Categoria A, B e C pela Petrobras, atuando diretamente com equipes de inspeção e auditoria.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado das regulamentações da ANP que afetam operações de perfuração, relatórios, conteúdo local e licenciamento operacional.
  • Compreensão dos protocolos RASMA (Rig Acceptance Safety and Maintenance Assessment) da Petrobras, incluindo revisão periódica e mitigação de riscos.
  • Conhecimento abrangente das NRs relacionadas ao setor de óleo e gás, incluindo NR-10 (Segurança em Eletricidade), NR-12 (Máquinas), NR-13 (Vasos de Pressão), NR-20 (Inflamáveis) e NR-37 (Operações Offshore).

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia de Petróleo, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mínimo de 10 a 15 anos de experiência em operações de perfuração, incluindo funções de liderança.
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos e auditorias operados pela Petrobras.
  • Certificações em controle de poços (IWCF/IADC), HSE e conformidade regulatória.
  • Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de resolução de problemas, com capacidade de engajar partes interessadas técnicas e não técnicas.
  • Inglês Fluente

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first

Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a legacy of innovation, evolving from skilled nursing and hospitals to one of the largest health benefits providers in the US. At the core of this evolution is Humana’s Insurance Segment, which provides Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and other health plans to millions. By integrating insurance with care delivery through CenterWell, Humana is improving healthcare access, coordination, and affordability for its members.

Humana’s Insurance Segment Strategy team plays a pivotal role in defining the future of Humana’s Medicare and Medicaid businesses, which generate the majority of the company’s total revenue and earnings. Comprised of experienced professionals from top-tier consulting firms and leading healthcare organizations, the team works closely with senior leaders across the enterprise to drive high-profile strategy projects that address the business’s most complex challenges and biggest opportunities.

Humana is seeking an experienced team member with meaningful strategy consulting or healthcare strategy experience to join this team. As an Insurance Strategy Lead, you will directly contribute to high-impact strategy projects, engage with executive leadership, and develop actionable recommendations that shape Humana’s long-term direction. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where your insights will help inform Board-level discussions and enterprise-wide strategic priorities.

As a Lead, you will be responsible for deconstructing complex business challenges, conducting targeted research and analysis, and developing sound, data-driven recommendations that help guide Humana’s strategic direction. Your role will be instrumental in synthesizing strategic choices being made across the business unit into cohesive, actionable plans that drive both growth and profitability while improving the health of Humana’s members. You will also help shape implementation considerations and work closely with business owners to transition strategies into execution, ensuring that recommendations translate into meaningful business impact.

Recent example projects include development of a 5-year growth strategy for Humana’s Insurance business, developing a refreshed membership acquisition strategy, identifying key go-to-market priorities, assessing the performance of strategic initiatives and business areas, evolving key facets of the Medicare Advantage growth strategy, and identifying improvement opportunities for a key business function.

About the role: We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).   • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).

Main responsibilities

Sua missão será:

  • Liderar o time técnico – Desenvolvedores, QAs e Suporte Técnico – de uma Squad, garantindo uma cultura de excelência de entrega em termos de prazos e qualidade;
  • Atuar com maestria em todo ciclo de vida de um projeto de software: entendimento das necessidades de negócio, refinamentos técnicos, definição de arquitetura, delivery, testes automatizados, integração contínua, deploy contínuo;

  • Transmitir seus conhecimentos para o time de forma constante, contribuindo para o crescimento técnico de toda equipe.

Requirements and skills

Para assumir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência de no mínimo 3 anos liderando times de desenvolvimento;

  • Domínio das melhores práticas em qualidade de desenvolvimento, especificamente Design Patterns, S.O.L.I.D e Testes Unitários/API/Automatizados;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais, performance e estratégias de uso;
  • Experiência com DevOps, Continuous Delivery Pipeline (CI, CD, Containers, Dynamic Environment Configuration);
  • Experiência no uso de alguma ferramenta de IA (ex. Cursor, Github Copilot).

Além disso, será considerado como diferencial:

  • Experiência com observabilidade (ex. Datadog, CloudWatch, Kibana, etc);
  • Terraform/Docker;
  • Já tenha trabalhado com nuvens públicas (AWS, Azure, etc.);
  • Experiência com Microserviços.

E esperamos que você coloque em prática algumas características:

title: Technology Systems Analyst II
description:
Overview

When you think of InComm Payments, think of Innovative Payments Technology. We were founded over 30 years ago and continue to be a pioneer in the payment (FinTech) industry. Since our inception, we have grown to be a team of over 3,000 employees in 35 countries around the world. We own over 400 global technical patents and a network that includes over 525,000 points of retail distribution that points to our industry expertise.

We are significantly growing our Engineering and IT teams in Brazil and are focused on finding talent for various financial technology (Fintech) engineering, database, development, and testing teams.

InComm Payments is highly focused on our people and their growth, and we work hard to make a career at InComm Payments meaningful and rewarding. We value innovation, quality, passion, integrity and responsibility in all that we do, and we are looking for great people to join our team as we move forward towards a very bright future. We anticipate developing future leaders for our teams in Brazil!

Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses! All positions are CLT.

You can learn more about InComm Payments by visiting our Website or connecting with us on LinkedIn, YouTube, Twitter, Facebook, or Instagram.

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a senior Systems Analyst with experience in payments/fintech to join our team! In this role, you will be responsible for creating SQL queries, interpreting SQL scripts, continuously monitoring assigned platforms for performance, providing high-level design for data flows, engaging in deployments, and collaborating with cross functional teams to best enhance platforms and support our customers. You will also serve as an owner of the platforms and be knowledgeable of all operational and maintenance activities up to monitoring the efforts. Professional English communication skills required.

This position is CLT and Fully Remote in Brazil . Benefits include health and dental insurance, meal and restaurant vouchers, fixed monthly stipend for internet and mobile expenses, InComm hardware/software, and annual bonuses!

Responsibilities

  • Continuously monitor assigned platforms for performance and operational excellence ensuring established SLAs are maintained and contributes recommendations for process and/or platform improvements
  • Exhibit a sense of ownership for assigned platform(s), and maintain/grow the knowledgebase of Clients, Merchants, and Users serviced by the platform
  • Periodically survey platform customers to gauge and drive improvements in customer satisfaction, where appropriate
  • Create SQL queries and understand SQL scripts to enhance the platform and support customers.
  • Parse, analyze and understand system log files
  • Strong knowledge of payment message formats and data file formats associated with assigned platforms.
  • Proactively monitor the performance of assigned platforms and raise potential performance or reliability issues to development and support teams to investigate/address, to avoid impact on system availability/customer experience
  • Plan and coordinate payment solutions and enhancements with the development team
  • Meet and coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to establish project scope, system goals, and requirements
  • Provides input on high-level design documents for data and message flows and detailed technical requirements
  • Collaborate with QA testing in the research and writing of test cases along with participating in system testing
  • Engaged in production deployment for coordination and verification as the owner of the platform
  • Owner of platform and knowledgeable of all operational and maintenance activities up to monitoring the efforts
  • Create and maintain platform documentation including process flows, design/architecture, operational playbooks, escalation procedures, and training materials as needed.
  • Create Software Release and Change Management tickets as well as internal IT request tickets for system updates

Qualifications

  • Associate, Technologo, or Bachelor Degree preferred
  • Ideal candidate will have experience in the payment industry in one of the following roles as a System Analyst, Business Analyst, Project Manager, QA Engineer, or Software Engineer role
  • Work effectively alone and in team environments with quality and timely results
  • Demonstrated ability to work with Customers
  • Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work
  • Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Professional English communication skills.
  • Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills
  • Support after-hours coverage/escalation

Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a Landing Page Strategist, you’ll play a critical role in executing and optimizing high-performing landing pages that drive real business results across lead generation, paid media, and eCommerce campaigns.You’ll work closely with senior strategists, paid media teams, lifecycle marketers, account managers, and creatives to support the day-to-day management of our clients’ landing page programs. This includes strategic planning, copywriting, QA, stakeholder communication, A/B testing, reporting, and ongoing optimization.This is a client-facing, detail-oriented role ideal for someone with a passion for conversion strategy, digital marketing, and performance design. You’ll gain deep hands-on experience across the entire landing page lifecycle while helping execute and grow one of our most impactful service lines.

Responsibilities:

Client Execution & Project Management

  • Own the execution of landing page deliverables across strategy, copywriting, design feedback, development handoff, QA, and launch
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for internal teams and assist with client communication when needed
  • Translate paid media strategy and campaign briefs into high-converting landing page experiences
  • Work within structured workflows and project management tools (e.g., Asana) to track deliverables and meet timelines
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Paid Media, Lifecycle, Creative, and Development teams to align messaging, offers, and user experience
  • Assist in developing and refining landing page strategies that align with funnel stages and campaign goals
  • Conduct CRO audits, scroll map/click map reviews, and post-launch performance analysis to surface insights and optimizations
  • Support A/B testing strategy creation, execution, and reporting
  • Apply best practices in messaging hierarchy, user experience, and mobile-first design
  • Maintain knowledge of platform and ad network guidelines (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, etc.)

Content & QA Support

  • Draft or refine landing page copy tailored to target personas, offers, and funnel stage
  • Review landing pages for accuracy, responsiveness, and proper integration with forms, calendars, pixels, and CRMs
  • Work with developers and creative teams to ensure pages meet quality standards prior to launch
  • Work alongside the Managing Director to operationalize best practices and document repeatable workflows
  • Help maintain and improve internal tools such as audit templates, performance trackers, and testing roadmaps
  • Contribute to ongoing training and resource development for internal teams and freelancers
  • Proactively identify areas for improvement across design, process, messaging, or reporting

Role Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in CRO or running Landing Page projects (agency experience preferred)..
  • Portfolio of work examples with proven results
  • Experience working with Landing Page & CRM platforms: Unbounce, Hubspot, Marketo, etc
  • Experience working with design platforms like Figma
  • Experience with user behavior tools like Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, etc

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Implement AI-driven automation 50%+ of landing page workflows.
  • On-time delivery of landing page milestones (strategy, copy, QA, launch)
  • Conversion rate performance vs. benchmark or prior page
  • Number of launched landing pages per month
  • Client satisfaction and internal team feedback
  • A/B testing velocity and learnings logged

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Execute Flawlessly Across the Landing Page Lifecycle – Deliver end-to-end execution across strategy, copy, QA, and launch
  • Drive Conversion-Focused Results – Apply best practices and insights to improve performance and meet client goals
  • Collaborate Across Teams – Serve as the operational glue between Paid, Lifecycle, Creative, and Dev teams
  • Grow Through Process and Learning – Support the growth of the landing page program through repeatable systems and continuous improvement

Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

About Your Team

At Teachable, our Data team aims to support company data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Data, you lead our Data Engineering team and partner closely with product and business teams, making strategic technical decisions.

About You

You have a background experience with modern data architectures and engineering tools, are comfortable in supporting the design and optimization of data pipelines, modeling databases, and are constantly seeking ways to enhance data reliability, scalability, and the value delivered to stakeholders.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage and mentor a team of data engineers, besides define the team’s mission, direction, and strategy in alignment with the Data team and business goals.
  • Lead large-scale technical projects and cross-team initiatives and guide technical leads in making impactful architectural and data modeling decisions.
  • Represent the Data Engineering team across the company and act as a strong partner to technology and business stakeholders.
  • Balance build vs. buy decisions to maximize impact and efficiency in product analytics and infrastructure.
  • Manage technical debt while ensuring scalability, reliability and maintainability.
  • Work with product and business teams, balancing technical depth with strategic impact.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven track record managing technical teams, including technical leads and managers.
  • A problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and a drive to make processes more efficient.
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure (MWAA, RDS, S3, IAM permissioning model).
  • Strong experience with orchestration/workflow tools (e.g.: Airflow).
  • Understanding of infrastructure as code (Terraform).
  • Knowledge of batch and streaming frameworks (e.g.: Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Streaming).
  • Good communication skills, fluent English proficiency and ability to operate in an international environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with AWS DMS, MKS, SQS/SNS, AppFlow, Data Build Tool (DBT).
  • Understanding of Data Mesh or domain-driven data architectures.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data catalog tools.

This is a fully remote role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Preferably candidates based on Belo Horizonte or São Paulo. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time, and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

Role Description
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented IT Procurement Administrator to support the IT department in managing third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with IT standards, and driving operational efficiency. This role is pivotal in maintaining strong supplier relationships, overseeing risk and compliance processes, and supporting procurement and security initiatives across the business.
The post holder will work alongside global colleagues in supporting the business and would be expected to work across multiple time zones, on a per-project basis. This position provides exposure to a broad range of IT-related projects and activities, and new technology introductions to the business.
Principle Accountabilities:
Vendor & Supplier Management
  • Manage relationships with third-party vendors delivering core IT solutions to Airswift.
  • Oversee the supplier onboarding process.
  • Ensure vendor compliance with contractual obligations and agreed SLAs.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to identify cost savings and eliminate inefficiencies.
  • Proactively monitor contract expiry dates to ensure timely re-negotiation and renewals.
  • Developing and implementing streamlined procurement processes for technology expenditure, ensuring consistent management of both new and renewal spending.
  • Track and analyze supplier performance using Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Working in collaboration with the Quality Dept, provide regular ISMS performance reports for the Group IT Director and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor user access and IT licenses, ensuring timely deactivation of unused accounts.
IT Risk & Compliance
  • Oversee the IT Risk Management process.Including maintaining the Risk Register, coordinating Risk Review meetings, and monitoring risk treatment plans to ensure that these are deployed by the Risk Owners in a timely manner.
  • Identify and escalate potential risks in service delivery, performance, or spending that may impact IT or the wider business.
  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of policies and procedures aligned with ISO27001 standards.

Procurement & Budget Management

  • Support the development and implementation of streamlined procurement processes for IT expenditure.
  • Manage supplier costs in line with the IT budget and ensure transparency for cross-charging business units for usage.
  • Handle contract renewals for key IT services, ensuring cost-effective and aligned solutions.

Security & Awareness

  • Assist the Bids team with security questionnaires and compliance documentation.
  • Lead internal security awareness initiatives, including phishing campaigns and “Did You Know?” updates.
  • Lead the implementation and maintenance of relevant policies and standard operating procedures in line with ISO27001 requirements.
  • Develop and maintain training materials for the Information Security Management System (ISMS) and requirements of ISO27001.

Innovation & Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to promote innovation within the technology ecosystem.
  • Communicate relevant technology and security updates to the business to drive adoption and best practices.
  • Collaborate with the Quality Dept on matters relating to ISO27001 compliance and opportunities for improvement, such as those identified through internal audits.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • Proven experience in IT administration, vendor management, or procurement support.
  • Strong understanding of IT compliance frameworks, particularly ISO27001 would be ideal.
  • Proficiency in Excel and dashboard reporting tools.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Experience with contract negotiation and supplier onboarding is a plus.

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes, such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.

Objetivo do Cargo

A posição de Especialista Tributário tem como objetivo liderar tecnicamente as estratégias de compliance e defesa tributária da empresa, com foco em tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL), atuando de forma proativa na gestão de riscos, na condução de processos de contencioso administrativo, interpretação e normatização de legislação federal e na identificação de oportunidades fiscais. Este profissional será referência técnica na área, com papel consultivo e estratégico junto às demais áreas da empresa e escritórios externos.

Responsabilidades do Cargo

  • Liderar tecnicamente a apuração e revisão dos tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL).

  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias nos processos tributários, com foco em automação e eficiência, gestão de metas e indicadores da área, aprimorando suas habilidades para um perfil crítico e analítico.
  • Representar a empresa junto a órgãos públicos e escritórios jurídicos em temas tributários.
  • Monitorar e interpretar mudanças na legislação tributária federal, em especial a Reforma Tributária, propondo estratégias de adequação de processos internos e aproveitamento de oportunidades.
  • Ser membro ativo e protagonista dos impactos da Reforma Tributária do Consumo (e outras reformas) desde a interpretação da legislação até adequações sistêmicas.
  • Apoiar em planejamento tributário, projetos especiais e na estruturação de operações com impacto fiscal.
  • Participar de comitês internos e reuniões estratégicas com áreas como Jurídico, Contabilidade, Planejamento Financeiro e Negócios e correlatas.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico para analistas da área.
  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico e elaboração de reportes para e com a matriz internacional.
  • Atendimento a auditorias externas/internas.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior completo em Ciências Contábeis, Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês avançado (imprescindível para comunicação com matriz, relatórios e auditorias).

  • Ferramentas: Familiaridade com sistemas ERP (SAP, Sonda, Portal LG, Workday, entre outros) e ferramentas de apuração fiscal.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Direito Tributário ou Planejamento Tributário será considerado um diferencial.

title: Channel Account Executive – MSP
description:
About Us

Sophos is a global leader and innovator of advanced security solutions for defeating cyberattacks. The company acquired Secureworks in February 2025, bringing together two pioneers that have redefined the cybersecurity industry with their innovative, native AI-optimized services, technologies and products. Sophos is now the largest pure-play Managed Detection and Response (MDR) provider, supporting more than 28,000 organizations. In addition to MDR and other services, Sophos’ complete portfolio includes industry-leading endpoint, network, email, and cloud security that interoperate and adapt to defend through the Sophos Central platform. Secureworks provides the innovative, market-leading Taegis XDR/MDR, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), next-gen SIEM capabilities, managed risk, and a comprehensive set of advisory services. Sophos sells all these solutions through reseller partners, Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) worldwide, defending more than 600,000 organizations worldwide from phishing, ransomware, data theft, other everyday and state-sponsored cybercrimes. The solutions are powered by historical and real-time threat intelligence from Sophos X-Ops and the newly added Counter Threat Unit (CTU). Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at

Role Summary

The Channel Account Executive (CAE) is accountable for managing strategic Sophos partners. They are responsible for developing joint business plans with partners to hit revenue and profitability targets by developing new MDR, services, MSP, and next-gen portfolio customer opportunities, up-sell, and cross-selling to existing customers and renewals.

title: UX Designer - Remote - Brazil
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a UX Designer (Remote) candidate that resides in Brazil.

The UX Designer will play a key role in delivering high-quality, user-focused design solutions that support sales, marketing, and purchasing initiatives. This position is responsible for creating intuitive, engaging digital experiences and contributing visually compelling assets that align with brand objectives.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in UX principles and visual design, leveraging user research, wireframes, and prototyping to improve interfaces and optimize user journeys. They will collaborate across departments to deliver purposeful, innovative design solutions that elevate both function and form reporting to the Creative Director.

Important: While this role is open to candidates across any location in Brazil, High Tide brands do not operate or market in Brazil. This role will support our global markets in North America and Europe.

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the creation of user-centered, visually engaging design strategies that enhance customer engagement and brand connection across digital platforms.
  • Translate complex concepts into clean, elegant user experiences through intuitive flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes.
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and competitive audits to uncover insights that inform visual design decisions.
  • Design user journeys, personas, and sitemaps that bring clarity and intention to navigation and structure.
  • Apply responsive and accessible design principles to ensure seamless experiences across all devices and audiences.
  • Collaborate with developers to ensure design intent is maintained in final implementation—no coding is required.
  • Use design analytics tools (e.g., Hotjar, Google Analytics) to evaluate user engagement and optimize visual UX outcomes.
  • Stay current with design trends, emerging tools, and UX best practices to continuously elevate digital design standards.

Web Design Responsibilities

  • Design aesthetically refined, responsive websites and digital experiences that reflect brand identity and drive user engagement.
  • Craft visually dynamic layouts, landing pages, and UI components with a focus on clarity, hierarchy, and storytelling.
  • Work closely with marketing, e-commerce, and content teams to align design with strategic goals, user needs, and brand tone.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and brand style guides to ensure consistency and scalability across all touchpoints.
  • Design complementary digital assets such as banners, email templates, promotional graphics, and pop-ups that support campaign objectives.
  • Provide design QA during handoff and development phases to uphold visual quality and ensure design consistency.

Organizational & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contribute to a creative and collaborative team environment by participating in critiques, brainstorming sessions, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Manage multiple design projects with efficiency, consistently meeting deadlines while maintaining attention to visual and UX detail.
  • Maintain organized, well-labeled design files and ensure work is version-controlled and accessible across shared platforms.

Qualifications

What We’re Looking For

Education:

  • 3 – 4-year Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Graphic Design, Interaction Design, or a related visual design discipline.

Skills & Experience:

  • 3 – 5 years of experience in UX and visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing modern, clean, and user-focused work across web, mobile, and email.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), Figma, and Mac-based design workflows.
  • Expertise in user experience design principles, user interface best practices, and visual storytelling across digital platforms.
  • Familiarity with email marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo) and design standards for high-performance email campaigns.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present design concepts and rationale to diverse stakeholders.
  • Collaborative spirit, visual creativity, and a passion for delivering design that delights users and drives results.

Why Join High Tide

  • Be part of one of the largest global cannabis and accessories companies.
  • Join a collaborative, team that values speed, ownership, and creativity.
  • Fully remote role with flexibility and meaningful impact.

How to Apply

To apply, please submit:

  • Yourresume in English.
  • (Optional) Any relevant portfolio or example campaigns that reflect your expertise and experience.

About Us

High Tide Inc. is the leading community-grown, retail-forward cannabis enterprise engineered to unleash the full value of the world’s most powerful plant and is the second-largest cannabis retailer globally by store count⁷ . High Tide (HITI) is uniquely-built around the cannabis consumer, with wholly-diversified and fully-integrated operations across all components of cannabis, including:

  • Bricks & Mortar Retail: Canna Cabana is the largest cannabis retail chain in Canada, with 200 plus current locations spanning British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario and growing. In 2021, Canna Cabana became the first cannabis discount club retailer in the world.
  • Retail Innovation: Fastendr is a unique and fully automated technology that employs retail kiosks to facilitate a better buying experience through browsing, ordering and pickup.
  • Consumption Accessories: High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory e-commerce platforms across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.
  • E-commerce Platforms: High Tide operates a suite of leading accessory sites across the world, including Grasscity.com, Smokecartel.com, Dailyhighclub.com, and Dankstop.com.

CBD: High Tide continues to cultivate the possibilities of consumer CBD through Nuleafnaturals.com, FABCBD.com, blessedcbd.de and blessedcbd.co.uk.

Wholesale Distribution: High Tide keeps that cannabis category stocked with wholesale solutions via Valiant.

Licensing: High Tide continues to push cannabis culture forward through fresh partnerships and license agreements under the Famous Brandz name.

High Tide consistently moves ahead of the currents, having been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 by the Globe and Mail’s Report on Business Magazine, and was named as one of the top 10 performing diversified industries stocks in both 2022 and 2024 TSX Venture 50. High Tide was also ranked number one in the retail category on the Financial Times list of Americas’ Fastest Growing Companies for 2024.

As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

If you are based in São Paulo or Porto Alegre, you are welcome to work from one of our offices on a flexible schedule.

The Opportunity

As a Data Engineer part of our growing Data Science team, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines, enabling efficient data integration, storage, and processing across our various data sources. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and other technical stakeholders, to ensure data quality and support data-driven decision-making.

  • Demonstrate a commitment to accessibility and ensure that your work considers and positively impacts others

Qualifications

  • BSc, MSc, and/or PhD in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, CS, or another related subject

  • Have actively participated in the design and development of data architectures
  • Hands-on experience in developing and optimizing data pipelines
  • Experience working with databases and data modeling projects, as well as practical experience utilizing SQL
  • Effective English communication - able to explain technical and non-technical concepts to different audiences
  • Experience with a general-purpose programming language such as Python or Scala
  • Ability to work well in teams and interact effectively with others
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks simultaneously while meeting deadlines

Bonus Points

  • Cloud platforms and services, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Big data tools such as Hadoop, Spark or Kafka
  • Orchestration tools such as Airflow
  • NoSQL databases
  • Containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Agile development environment and familiarity with Agile methodologies

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

In addition to being part of an international and innovative consultancy company, you will have:

  • A Global Innovation Hub: Be part of an international consultancy at the forefront of technology
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life
  • Cutting-Edge Tech Playground: Dive into the latest technologies and shape the future of digital solutions
  • Prestigious Partnerships: Collaborate with world-renowned brands, making a real impact in the market
  • Growth-Centric Environment: Thrive in our collaborative ecosystem with a clear career development path
  • Global Exposure: Embrace optional international travel opportunities to broaden your horizons

Some of our benefits:

  • Health and dental plan
  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

  2. 2. Como faço para me inscrever? As inscrições são realizadas online. Basta acessar tomeducacao.gupy.io, preencher o formulário e enviar os documentos solicitados. Após a inscrição, você receberá um e-mail de confirmação.
  3. 3. Quais documentos são necessários para a inscrição? Os documentos exigidos podem variar de acordo com o cargo, mas geralmente giram em torno do currículo atualizado. Caso você receba uma oferta de contratação, outros documentos serão solicitados.
  4. 4. Há uma taxa de inscrição? Não, a inscrição no processo seletivo é totalmente gratuita.
  5. 5. Qual é o prazo final para inscrição? As inscrições estão abertas até o dia 20/09/2025. Inscreva-se o quanto antes para garantir a sua participação.
  6. 6. Como será o processo de seleção? O processo seletivo é composto por várias etapas, incluindo: Formulário de triagem, Teste Lógica, Entrevista com RH, Entrevista final.
  7. 7. Quando os resultados serão divulgados? Os resultados das diferentes etapas do processo seletivo serão enviados por e-mail. Acompanhe o calendário na página da Gupy para as datas.
  8. 8. Posso corrigir ou atualizar minha inscrição após enviá-la? Sim, você pode atualizar seus dados antes do prazo final de inscrição, acessando sua conta no site e fazendo as alterações necessárias diretamente no site tomeducacao.gupy.io.
  9. 9. Como posso acompanhar o status da minha inscrição? Você pode acompanhar o status de sua inscrição e do processo seletivo na área "Minha Inscrição" no nosso site tomeducacao.gupy.io, onde estarão as atualizações sobre cada etapa.
  10. 10. O que devo fazer se não receber o e-mail de confirmação da inscrição? Verifique sua caixa de spam ou lixo eletrônico. Caso o e-mail não esteja lá, entre em contato com a equipe de suporte pelo e-mail ou pelo telefone .
  11. 11. Há vagas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD)? Sim, o processo seletivo conta com vagas destinadas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).
  12. 12. Qual é a duração do processo seletivo? O processo seletivo pode variar em duração, mas normalmente leva entre 20 a 60 dias, desde o início das inscrições até a divulgação do resultado final. Confira o andamento em seu e-mail ou no nosso site tomeducacao.com.br.
  13. 13. Onde posso encontrar mais informações sobre os cargos disponíveis? Todas as informações sobre as vagas, incluindo requisitos e responsabilidades, estão detalhadas na página do processo seletivo, disponível no nosso site tomeducacao.com.br.
  14. 14. E se eu tiver mais dúvidas? Caso tenha outras perguntas, você pode entrar em contato com nossa equipe pelo e-mail ou pelo telefone .

description:
Job description

A Funcional Health Tech acredita que a saúde é o pilar principal da vida das pessoas, por isso, quebramos barreiras para promovê-la de forma sustentável.

Para realizar nosso propósito, inovamos todos os dias, unindo pessoas, tecnologia e dados para prover o ecossistema da saúde com soluções que geram eficiência e sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia.

Aqui, você participará, de maneira direta ou indireta, da criação de novas soluções para os mais diversos serviços de saúde, pois essa é a missão diária de todos nós na Funcional. Pesquisamos, criamos e fazemos acontecer, pois isso está em nosso DNA.

Main responsibilities

Sua missão como Analista de Ciências de Dados será:

  • Desenvolver análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos para identificar padrões de comportamento e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Estruturar hipóteses de negócio e validar estatisticamente seus impactos.
  • Explorar e tratar grandes volumes de dados de saúde, garantindo qualidade e consistência.
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia de dados e visualização de dados para disponibilizar análises e modelos em escala.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações que traduzam resultados complexos em insights claros para áreas de negócio.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos estatísticos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades que esperamos que você possua:

  • Formação em Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em análise estatística e modelagem preditiva.
  • Conhecimento sólido em estatística aplicada (testes de hipóteses, regressões, modelos probabilísticos);
  • Linguagens de programação: Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) e R;
  • SQL para manipulação de bases de dados relacionais.

Diferenciais que vão fazer você chamar nossa atenção:

  • Experiência no setor de saúde será um diferencial (dados de operadoras, indústria farmacêutica ou varejo farmacêutico).
  • Noções de machine learning avançado e técnicas de modelagem preditiva.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git).

Additional information

Como é trabalhar aqui na Funcional Health Tech:

  • Nosso time é incrível, colaboramos e fazemos juntos para ir mais longe.
  • Nossa cultura é ágil e estamos em constante evolução.
  • Incentivamos o crescimento profissional e o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores com diversas ações e encontros, através de plataforma de treinamentos e webinars mensais, além da “Baratona”, que é o nosso Hackathon interno.

A Funcional reconhece que a diversidade traz benefícios para o negócio e que um ambiente plural e colaborativo é propício para a inovação acontecer. Desta forma, nossas oportunidades abraçam todos os talentos, sem distinção de cor, raça, gênero ou qualquer condição de deficiência. Todos os talentos podem participar igualitariamente nos processos seletivos da Funcional. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.

This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

Climate Finance Tracking

Since 2011, CPI has published the Global Landscape of Climate Finance series which has been the global benchmark for robust information on climate finance, providing foundational data for the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change 6th Assessment Report, and the UNFCCC’s Biennial Assessment among others. CPI also develops deep dive analysis tracking climate finance flows at sectoral, national and regional levels including the intersection of climate and SDG goals, agrifood systems finance, adaptation and renewable energy working with partners such as the Global Center on Adaptation (GCA), International Development Finance Club (IDFC), the Glasgow Financial Alliance for Net Zero, Bloomberg, the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) and many more.

Our unique tracking analysis covers both public and private finance data, providing access through concise reporting and interactive data visualization. Our research provides a baseline and compelling analysis against which to measure progress. This enables us to drive informed climate finance policymaking through three key levers:

  • Flows – what investment is flowing to whom
  • Needs – what is the investment gap to deliver on climate goals
  • Impact – what is proving effective and efficient in climate finance

Position Summary

This position supports the delivery of key objectives across CPI’s strategic priorities, under the supervision and guidance of Brazil's Research Director. CPI offers a challenging environment that requires independent thinking, collaboration, and pragmatic problem solving. This Senior Analyst role will be focused within the CPI’s Climate Finance Tracking workstream, including tracking national climate finance flows, aligning finance with low-carbon and climate-resilient development, and assessing key gaps in financing climate action at regional and sectoral levels as well as managing relationships with partners and key stakeholders.

Senior Analysts undertake robust and careful analysis, drawing on methodologies from micro- and macroeconomics, public policy, regulatory economics, finance, behavioural science, risk management, statistics, law, engineering, and other disciplines. In conducting analysis, Senior Analysts work in close cooperation, often leading, a range of partners from the policy, finance, and corporate spheres, as well as with CPI teams across the globe.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • Perform rigorous quantitative and qualitative evaluation of national and international climate finance mechanisms and climate and energy policies, risk management, and interactions between public and private actors and resources
  • Lead/Manage climate finance tracking projects as designated by, and under the direction of senior management, develop, manage, and implement complex research assignments and analytical projects
  • Lead the writing and editing of high-quality CPI products, including full reports, executive summaries, blogs, and presentations. Produce high-quality materials that are fit for purpose time and within budget
  • Identify opportunities to develop and consolidate work streams and lead development of funding proposals under guidance of senior management
  • Train, manage and provide guidance to junior staff on professional work practices and lead by example
  • Engage clients, advise policymakers and investors on the implications of research findings
  • Communicate and collaborate with CPI staff working around the globe

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential:

  • Post-graduate or master's degree with 5-7 years in Economics, Finance, Investment or another relevant field
  • Significant professional experience in financial services, management consulting, international nonprofit, government, and/or a multilateral institution
  • Strong understanding of climate finance and the financial sector actors and actions that are needed to mobilize effective finance towards adaptation and resilience activities
  • Excellent project management skills including time management, task delegation and prioritization, and communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage and engage stakeholders in the financial sector
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English

Beneficial:

  • Significant experience in research and analysis related to climate/green finance; experience across the public and private sectors in climate/green investments, taxonomies, net zero finance
  • Advanced user of MS Office, particularly Excel; knowledge of SQL, R, Python is a plus
  • Sector-specific or multi-sector climate finance expertise
  • Willingness to travel

Personal Attributes:

  • Independent, analytical mind with an excellent track record of applying sound financial, political, and strategic judgment to complex issues
  • Proven leadership skills, willingness and ambition to take initiative
  • Strong commitment to topics related to climate change and a desire to make a difference
  • Flexibility, professionalism, enthusiasm for team work, and ability to interact with diverse people; strong attention to detail, organization, time management, prioritization, and ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills

Position details

CPI is recruiting for a full-time position in our Rio de Janeiro office. CPI in Brazil hires through the Pontifical Catholic University of Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio) with a “CLT” contract. CPI has adopted a hybrid working policy whereby staff mix remote work with 2 regular days in the Rio de Janeiro office in Gávea.

CPI offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes 20 days leave, office closure between Christmas and New Year, 5 days study leave, USD 500 professional development budget and possibility to enrol on PUC’s courses.

Salaries are based on experience and market.

To apply

CPI Commitment

Climate Policy Initiative is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion and we are working to embed DEI across every facet of our organisation. title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Go or Node or Java)
description:
Overview

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days PTO, one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays

Sales Executive analyses local market trends and competitor activity to generate new future business for the hotel.

Conheça a Nova Escola

A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil

Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.

Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org, Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.

64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.

Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!

Trabalhamos com

O Educador no centro: Para nós, a transformação acontece através das professoras e professores de escola pública. Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.

Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.

Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Juntos e Diversos: Para nós, a diversidade, a inclusão e os conhecimentos multidisciplinares são pilares fundamentais para as nossas práticas, tanto nas ações que desenvolvemos com/para os educadores do Brasil quanto em iniciativas internas. Acreditamos que pessoas com diferentes trajetórias e pontos de vista se complementam e podem compartilhar um mesmo propósito. Pensamos juntos para pensar maior.

Atitude Responsável: Para nós, agir com responsabilidade é uma prática contínua, tanto no trabalho quanto na vida. Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.

Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimora nossos processos.

OAgente de Peso e Balanceamento é responsável por realizar o planejamento e a execução de cálculos de peso e balanceamento das aeronaves, assegurando a correta distribuição da carga e a segurança da operação aérea, conforme os limites operacionais e regulatórios estabelecidos.

title: LATAM Sales Director, Mobility
description:
Summary

Identification Technologies’ (IDT’s) Business Unit Mobility is seeking a driven and experienced Sales Director to lead the sales of Mobility’s product portfolio in Latin America (LATAM). The Sales Director will take full ownership of the go-to-market (GTM) strategy, channel development and the growth of Mobility’s portfolio, which includes both physical and digital credentials. He or she will build and execute on a comprehensive sales and account management strategy to grow existing accounts and drive net-new revenue from new accounts within the industry and region. Also, the Sales Director will collaborate with existing LATAM sales staff, agents and business finders in the region maximizing Mobility’s revenue and success in the region. A deep understanding of the Latin American market and business culture is essential.

Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy : Define and execute the GTM strategy for Mobility’s product portfolio (physical and digital credentials) in the LATAM region, ensuring that the messaging and positioning align with the region’s unique market demands.
  • Sales Strategy & Market Development : Lead the development and execution of the sales strategy for Mobility’s portfolio.
  • Mobility Team Coordination : will collaborate with existing sales staff, agents and business finders in the region for the Mobility Business Unit.
  • Channel and Partner Management : Establish, manage, and maintain a robust ecosystem and channel network by identifying, onboarding, and training new distributors, resellers, system integrators and end-customers. Build strong relationships to maximize product availability, market reach and overall performance.
  • Territory Management : Travel regularly throughout the assigned territory to nurture existing customer relationships, cultivate new partnerships, and explore untapped business opportunities.
  • Business Development: Identify and pursue new business opportunities. Create comprehensive account plans to drive new revenue and expand existing accounts.
  • Customer Engagement: Engage with end-users, resellers, system integrators and end-customers to promote the benefits and applications of Mobility’s product portfolio. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through tailored solutions and ongoing support.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with marketing, technical, and product management teams to ensure alignment between market needs and product offerings. Provide feedback to guide product roadmaps and enhance solution offerings.
  • Industry Engagement: Represent the Mobility Business Unit at industry events, conferences, and meetings to enhance market visibility and establish HID as a leader in the region.
  • Performance Reporting: Deliver detailed performance metrics and regular reports on sales progress, sales performance, and GTM effectiveness.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience

  • A minimum of 8 years of demonstrable experience in business development and/or technical sales, preferably within the technology or RFID sector, with a proven track record of sales and a solid understanding of RFID technologies and the sales process.
  • The ideal candidate has 5+ years of sales experience in Latin America and a proven track record in driving revenue growth. They must excel in sales strategy and negotiations as well as understand regional market trends, and be fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese with English proficiency.
  • Proven ability to develop and manage a network of partners. An existing network in the LATAM region is advantageous.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work as part of a cross-functional team. Experience working effectively across various departments, such as marketing, product development, and technical teams, to drive results.
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills. Capable of managing multiple projects concurrently while adhering to deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail, thoroughness, and an ability to manage complex sales cycles.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in business or technology preferred.

Communication Skills

  • Ability to effectively communicate in the English, Spanish and/or Portuguese languages, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to develop presentations and write content as an industry subject matter expert.
  • Ability to present information to technical managers, “C-level” management, public groups, and/or boards of directors.
  • Ability to communicate in professional manner with the Sales team, Business Development Team, Product Marketing, and other departments within HID.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical journals, specifications, international technical standards, etc.

Computer Skills

  • Proficient in MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
  • Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce.com.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Employee works primarily in a home office environment outside of travel to customers.

Work Requirements

  • Compliance to all relevant HID Global policies and procedures related to Quality, Security, Safety, Business Continuity, and Environmental systems.
  • Up to 70% travel and fieldwork, including international travel may be required. Therefore, employee must possess, or be able to acquire a valid passport.
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the country in which you are hired.
